title: WPSS/2339/2025 of SURESH SINGH LUNTHI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 2339 of 2025
Suresh Singh Lunthi and others ......Petitioners
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ....Respondents
Present:
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the petitioners through video
conferencing.
Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, D.A.G. for the State.
Ms. Stuti Pandey, Advocate, holding brief of Mr. Ramji
Srivastava, Advocate for the respondent no.3
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.(Oral)
The petitioners seek direction to the respondent no.2/the
Director General, Medical Health, Dehradun ("the Director General") to
amend the requisition dated 26.09.2025 by deleting 11 post of Nursing
Officer from the new selection process with further direction to the
respondent no.3/Uttarakhand Medical Service Selection Board,
Dehradun ("the Board") to prepare a fresh waiting list by including the
names of all eligible candidates on the basis of their respective merit,
while taking into consideration the request made by the respondent
no.2/ the Director General on 18.11.2025.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the
record.
3. The respondent no.3/the Board issued an advertisement
on 11.03.2024 for appointment to the post of Nursing Officer, by way of
direct recruitment. On 14.12.2024, the final result was declared.
Thereafter, on 26.09.2025, fresh requisition was sent to the respondent

2
no.2/the Director General to the respondent no.3/the Board for
recruitment of 587 posts of Nursing Officers. It so happened that when
the requisition was still pending with the respondent no.3/the Board,
the respondent no.2/ the Director General made a communication to
the respondent no.3/the Board that pursuant to the advertisement
made in the year 2024, 4 candidates had requested for rejection of
their candidature, 5 candidates have already joined in other
departments and candidature of two candidates deserve to be rejected
which means the candidature of 11 candidates deserve to be rejected
pursuant to the advertisement dated 11.03.2024. A request was made
that fresh waiting list may be prepared.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the
petitioners did apply against the advertisement dated 11.03.2024,
issued by the respondent no.3/the Board. The selection was to be done
on the basis of passing year of the qualifying examination. The waiting
list pursuant to the advertisement dated 11.03.2024 was prepared
much later. The candidature of 11 selected candidates was to be
rejected. Therefore, the respondent no.2/the Director General made a
request to the respondent no.3/the Board to prepare the waiting list on
18.11.2025. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the
respondent no.3/the Board may be directed to take decision on it.
Learned counsel for the petitioners also submits that if there were
candidates, whose candidature was to be rejected, it ought to have
been rejected on time, so that next candidate could have been afforded
an opportunity to get the appointment.
5. Learned State counsel submits that the Uttarakhand
Selection List and Waiting List of Selected Candidates in Government

3
Services on the Basis of Selections Made By the Commission/Selection
Institutions By Conducting Competitive Examinations and Other
Selections Rules, 2023 ("the 2023 Rules") has been notified on
10.10.2023. It provides that the waiting list may be in operation for one
year or till the requisition is sent. He submits that the wait list cannot
be prepared or may not be effected post 26.09.2025, when fresh
requisition was sent by the respondent no.2/the Director General to
the respondent no.3/the Board. Learned State counsel also submits
that now wait list cannot be prepared because requisition for the
recruitment of Nursing Officer had already been sent by the respondent
no.2/the Director General on 26.09.2025 to the respondent no.3/the
Board and an advertisement has already been issued on 17.11.2025.
6. Pursuant to an advertisement dated 11.03.2024, the
selections have already over. For next selection, the respondent
no.2/the Director General has sent the requisition on 26.09.2025.
According to Rule 6 of the 2023 Rules, the waiting list cannot be
effective post sending of the requisition, which means, even if, any
waiting list was prepared after preparation of the merit list pursuant to
the advertisement dated 11.03.2024, that also comes to an end, the
moment requisition was sent on 26.09.2025.
7. The issue in the instant case is beyond that. In fact,
candidature of 11 candidates, who were selected pursuant to the
advertisement dated 11.03.2024, by the respondent no.3/the Board
were to be rejected. The respondent no.2/the Director General made a
communication on 18.11.2025 to the respondent no.3/the Board
requesting for preparation of the waiting list. Wait list cannot be
prepared post fresh requisition, which was sent on 26.09.2025. In fact,

4
in the instant case, the advertisement had already been issued on
17.11.2024.
8. Having considered, this Court is of the view that, there is
no reason to make any interference. Accordingly, the writ petition
deserves to be dismissed.
9. The writ petition is dismissed.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 31.12.2025
Jitendra
